O robô manda as candidaturas sozinho, pe: The robot sends applications by itself, through your own Gmail, using the résumé and the texts you wrote yourself in your profile — it never makes anything up. This feature is included in the Turbo and Máximo plans from day one (VIP is manual only: you choose and send each application). To use automatic sending, you pick the job source, adjust the filters and choose the profile, tap Start, and you can even close the app: it keeps sending on its own, one every ~{#} minutes (a human pace, to protect your Gmail account from being blocked by Google), until it reaches your plan's daily limit — then it pauses by itself and resumes sending the next day.
